content.text:
JavaScript is **completely blocked** on your Chrome! This is why nothing works.

Try **Samsung Internet Browser** - it's pre-installed on Samsung tablets and allows JS by default:
1. Open your apps
2. Tap **Samsung Internet** (not Chrome)
3. Go to https://arelorian.de

If you don't have Samsung Internet, try **Firefox** from Play Store.
